description: Classical nearly-singular 2x2 system (Trefethen/Bau-style example). Exact determinant is 1/10^8 != 0 and the exact rational solution of A x = (1,1) is x = (-72070000, 108080000). Binary float64 ranks it full and numpy.linalg.solve 'succeeds', but returns ~(-72070000.11, 108080000.17): close in relative norm, wrong as an exact answer. Shows silent float reliance producing a plausible but incorrect result.
